text: Cooking the curd in whey above 90 °C sets the protein so firmly that halloumi does not melt and can be grilled or fried; it is then folded with Cypriot mint leaves, giving its characteristic shape.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: fold
steps.note: Cypriot mint leaves are folded in, and the cheese is shaped into half-moons or rectangles of 150–350 g.
The cheese is salted only in its fresh type.
The cheese is ripened in salted whey of at most 6 % salt, only in its mature type.
